The .woff2 files here are the Google Fonts latin subsets, self-hosted so the game does not depend on a third-party fetch.

Anton (https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Anton) and Chakra Petch
(https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Chakra+Petch) are licensed under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1 (https://scripts.sil.org/OFL), which permits self-hosting. Vendored into this
directory by scripts/vendor-fonts.mjs so the app and the site do not depend on a third
party to render their own typography.
